properties.name: window-drag
properties.description: Skathi: whether pressing on this element moves the window, as on a title bar. Inherited: mark the bar with `move` and its buttons and inputs with `none`. The CSSWG spelling of Electron's `-webkit-app-region`.

values.name: move
values.description: Dragging the element moves the window.

values.name: none
values.description: The element takes its own clicks inside a `move` region.

properties.name: app-region
properties.description: Skathi: the Electron spelling of `window-drag`. Prefer `window-drag: move | none`.

properties.name: -webkit-app-region
properties.description: Skathi: the Electron spelling of `window-drag`. Prefer `window-drag: move | none`, except in Svelte, where svelte-check accepts only this spelling.

properties.name: --window-control
properties.description: Skathi: marks an app-drawn caption button, so the OS treats it as its own. On Windows 11, `maximize` brings the snap layouts flyout on hover. A custom property, so a browser ignores it.

values.name: maximize
values.description: The maximize / restore button; shows snap layouts on Windows 11.

values.name: none
values.description: Not a caption button; cancels an earlier rule.

properties.name: --shading
properties.description: Skathi: a GPU shader effect on this element only (not inherited, unlike other custom properties). One effect function, or `none`. Out-of-range arguments are clamped. An app's own effects, its shaders/*.slang, are named the same way.

values.name: none
values.description: No effect; cancels an earlier rule.

values.name: frost()
values.description: Blurred backdrop, crystalline grain and a rim highlight. `frost(<strength 0..1>, <radius 0..25px = 12px>?, <tint = rgba(255,255,255,.06)>?)`.

values.name: noise()
values.description: Film grain over the element. `noise(<amount 0..1>, <scale 0.05..64px = 1.5px>?, <speed 0..120 = 0, animated when above 0>?)`.

values.name: glow()
values.description: A soft halo centred on the element's rounded edge. `glow(<color = white>?, <radius 0..256px>, <strength 0..1>)`.
